name: TransposeDataTableNode
label: Transpose Data Table
description: Rotates a data table so that columns become rows (long format). Optionally groups data by key columns.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: KeyColumns
fields.label: Key Columns
fields.description: Comma-separated column names to keep as-is and repeat for each transposed value column.

fields.name: ValueColumns
fields.label: Value Columns
fields.description: Comma-separated column names whose values become rows. Empty means all non-key columns.
